:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]

*filter
:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:KUBE-FIREWALL - [0:0]
:KUBE-KUBELET-CANARY - [0:0]
:cali-to-wl-dispatch - [0:0]
-A INPUT -m comment --comment "cali:zkuE8qdwsVpH6Kd2" -m comment --comment "Accept packets from flows that pre-date BPF." -m mark --mark 0x5000000/0x5000000 -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m comment --comment "cali:yZFRZmIXI6AqI8Di" -m comment --comment "REJECT/rst packets from unknown TCP flows." -m mark --mark 0x5000000/0x5000000 -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset
-A INPUT -m comment --comment "cali:d6kO_Tm_dMRk4KKT" -m comment --comment "Drop packets from unknown non-TCP flows." -m mark --mark 0x5000000/0x5000000 -j DROP
-A INPUT -i cali+ -m comment --comment "cali:JheEucsDZYJ7ze_r" -m mark --mark 0x1000000/0x1000000 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -i cali+ -m comment --comment "cali:R-egD3QPpT8eWthR" -m mark ! --mark 0x1000000/0x1000000 -j DROP
-A INPUT -j KUBE-FIREWALL
-A FORWARD -m comment --comment "cali:umcmOn0WnTNOKJrp" -m comment --comment "Pre-approved by BPF programs." -m mark --mark 0x3000000/0x3000000 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -i cali+ -m comment --comment "cali:NnQ109Z-tVFkJGc1" -m comment --comment "From workload without BPF seen mark" -m mark ! --mark 0x1000000/0x1000000 -j DROP
-A FORWARD -m comment --comment "cali:YmI_zfAgHIHbINEV" -m comment --comment "Mark pre-established flows." -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j MARK --set-xmark 0x8000000/0x8000000
-A FORWARD -o cali+ -m comment --comment "cali:-EFgmtwMJVO64q9s" -m comment --comment "To workload, check workload is known." -j cali-to-wl-dispatch
-A FORWARD -i cali+ -m comment --comment "cali:wP1i1sEU71uRzM5d" -m comment --comment "To workload, mark has already been verified." -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -i bpfout.cali -m comment --comment "cali:3t5V_2xe4DFVlHBq" -m comment --comment "From " -m comment --comment "bpfout.cali" -m comment --comment " device, mark verified, accept." -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -m comment --comment "cali:CD7jZCSqPP_KjGsd" -m comment --comment "Mark pre-established flows." -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j MARK --set-xmark 0x8000000/0x8000000
-A OUTPUT -j KUBE-FIREWALL
-A KUBE-FIREWALL ! -s 127.0.0.0/8 -d 127.0.0.0/8 -m comment --comment "block incoming localnet connections" -m conntrack ! --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED,DNAT -j DROP
-A cali-to-wl-dispatch -m comment --comment "cali:7KNphB1nNHw80nIO" -m comment --comment "Unknown interface" -j DROP
COMMIT

-A DOCKER_POSTROUTING -s 127.0.0.11/32 -p tcp -m tcp --sport 36335 -j SNAT --to-source 192.168.5.2:53
-A DOCKER_POSTROUTING -s 127.0.0.11/32 -p udp -m udp --sport 50189 -j SNAT --to-source 192.168.5.2:53
-A cali-POSTROUTING -m comment --comment "cali:ggLCSZ9_r9uXnHIo" -m comment --comment "BPF loopback SNAT" -m mark --mark 0x3600000/0x3f00000 -j MASQUERADE --random-fully
-A cali-POSTROUTING -m comment --comment "cali:THrmnLhAi3cxMLBO" -j cali-fip-snat
-A cali-POSTROUTING -m comment --comment "cali:ez7mOi3T8N6rtIlJ" -j cali-nat-outgoing
-A cali-POSTROUTING -o tunl0 -m comment --comment "cali:pSEn2f1JTKrHlo8S" -m addrtype ! --src-type LOCAL --limit-iface-out -m addrtype --src-type LOCAL -j MASQUERADE --random-fully
-A cali-nat-outgoing -m comment --comment "cali:k9SjE1bWVYbIZgCm" -m mark --mark 0x3800000/0x3f00000 -j MASQUERADE --random-fully
